# GAME EDITION tabletop concepts — not manufactured or tested

First candidate: rear folding U-leg. All dimensions are provisional assumptions, not production drawings. Front face and bezel remain unchanged. Fixed legs and independent cradle are alternatives.

| Item | Folding A | Fixed B | Independent C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Assumed body diameter / thickness | 240 / 24 mm | same | same |
| Lean from vertical | 12° | 12° | 10–15° |
| Support width / depth | 140 / 130 mm | 150 / 140 mm | 180 / 150 mm |
| Storage | Fold behind; target 36–42 mm overall incl. knobs, unverified | deep | separate body/base |
| Manufacturing concept | bent aluminium U-leg, hinge pin, positive opening stop, reinforced rear plate | laser-cut/bent metal twin brackets, bolted rear plate | CNC wood or cast resin/metal cradle, soft lining, rear retention |

Assume body mass 0.8–1.2 kg only for concept comparison. Actual mass and centre of gravity must be measured after materials/shafts are selected. Rear screws must engage a reinforcing plate or metal inserts, not thin decorative skin. Assembly must never require holes through the front artwork. Two anti-roll contact pads under the body should be carried from the rear frame; verify their visibility and contact locations on a full-size mock-up. Use replaceable silicone/TPE pads on all three/four contact regions. Material compatibility and friction are untested.

Stability is NOT verified. Locate the measured centre-of-mass projection inside the support polygon with margin in every direction. For an assumed 0.8 kg body with only 20 mm of tipping margin, restoring moment is 0.8×9.81×0.020 ≈ 0.157 N·m. A 2 N horizontal push 150 mm above the table produces 0.30 N·m, which exceeds it: that example WOULD TIP. This is a counterexample, not an allowable operating force. Footprint dimensions alone do not prove safety. Recompute around front/rear/lateral edges with the real frame/base mass; test slip separately using measured friction.

Six independently adjustable hands require three concentric central shafts plus three subdial shafts (or another engineered linkage). Rear concentric knobs and three peripheral knobs are only keep-out zones in the drawing. Determine shaft torque, backlash, detents/friction, user finger clearances, rear access, and whether the body must be steadied with the other hand. The stand must not obstruct controls; stand/frame stiffness and foot torque resistance need actual tests. Folding version needs positive stop/retention, pinch clearance and hinge cycle testing. Independent cradle needs anti-lift retention that does not touch the visible bezel and a way to prevent the body rotating during knob use.

Before manufacturing: full-size cardboard/3D-printed dummy, weighed material/shaft sample, centre-of-mass measurement, all-six-control operation, front/back/side push/slip/tip tests, uneven-table tests, hinge/attachment endurance, folded storage, drop/transport and finger-access checks. Do not order production tooling from these sketches.

CLOCK EDITION is a separate mechanism project. Standard hour/minute/second operation, movement clearance and decorative subdials require independent engineering. This iteration prioritizes the manual GAME EDITION.
